summary: Raffaele Catà is a scholar in philosophy and Indology who completed a laurea at the University of Bologna in 2011–2012 under the supervision of Manlio Iofrida and co-supervision of Saverio Marchignoli.

Raffaele Pettazzoni (1883–1959) worked in religious studies and history/archaeology, earning a Ph.D. from Bologna (~1901–1905) and a PD from Sapienza Rome (-1913). He taught at Bologna (1914–1922) and was Professor of History of Religions at Sapienza (1923–1958).
Raffaele Torella (born 1950) is an Indologist and philosopher who studied under Raniero Gnoli (~1969–1974). He was a longtime faculty member at Sapienza University of Rome (~1976–2020).
Raffaello Orlando is a scholar of Sinology and Buddhist studies who earned his PhD from Princeton University in 1981 under the supervision of Denis Twitchett.

Raghu Ananthanarayanan works in philosophy and religious studies. A post-graduate in engineering from IIT Madras, he studied under Tirumalai Krishnamacharya and T. K. V. Desikachar, later teaching at Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram and visiting IIM Ahmedabad (attested 2010).

Raghu Vira (1902–1963) was an Indology, Buddhist, and Iranian/Central Asian studies scholar. Educated at Punjab and Leiden, he studied under Willem Caland and Ralph Lilley Turner, headed Sanskrit at Sanatan Dharma College (~1929–1946), and directed the IAIC (1934).

Raghunath Damodar Karmarkar (1893–1964) was an Indology and philosophy scholar. He served as principal of Sir Parashurambhau College (attested 1970) and held posts including Professor and Director of the Post-Graduate and Research Department at Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute.
Raghunath Giri was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Vamacharana Bhattacharya and served as department head at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith.

Rahul Parson is an Indology scholar who earned his PhD from the University of California, Berkeley (2004–2012). He served as Assistant Professor at the University of Colorado Boulder (2016–2020) and at UC Berkeley (2021).

Rahul Peter Das (born 1954) is an Indologist and linguist. Educated at Cologne and Hamburg under Klaus Ludwig Janert and Albrecht Wezler, he held posts at Hamburg, Bonn, and Groningen before becoming Professor of South Asian Studies at Halle-Wittenberg (~1994–2020).

Rahul Sankrityayan (1893–1963) was a scholar of Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology. He held a teaching position in Sanskrit at Vidyalankara Pirivena (1927) and taught Sanskrit and held a professorship at Saint Petersburg State University (1937, 1945–1947).

Raimo Anttila (1935–2023) was a linguist and Indologist who studied at Yale under Warren Crawford Cowgill (~1961–1966). He held academic posts at the University of California, Los Angeles (1965) and the University of Helsinki (1971–1976).

Raimon Panikkar (1918–2010) was a religious studies, philosophy, and Indology scholar. He earned doctorates from Complutense Madrid (under Juan Zaragüeta) and Lateran University, later holding posts at Complutense (1946–1953), Harvard (1966–1971), and UC Santa Barbara (1971–1978; emeritus ~1987–2010).

Raimond Gaita (born 1946) is a philosopher who studied at the University of Melbourne and University of Leeds. He served as Professor of Moral Philosophy at King's College London (1977–2011) and Foundation Professor of Philosophy at Australian Catholic University (1993–2011).

Raj Ballav Panda is an Indology scholar who studied at Rajendra University, Centurion University, and completed a Ph.D. at Banaras Hindu University (2022). He held faculty posts at Rajendra University (2018) and Klorofeel School (2022).
Raja Pathak is an Indologist who completed a Ph.D. at Banaras Hindu University (2014–2020) and holds a post at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University.

Raja Ram Shastri (1904–1991) worked in Indology and public service. He served as a Member of the Lok Sabha (~1971–1977) and Chairman of the Managing Committee at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University (attested 1976).

Rajan Gurukkal (born 1948) is a historian and Indologist educated at the University of Calicut and JNU. He served on the faculty at JNU and was Director of the School of Social Sciences at Mahatma Gandhi University (1988).

Rajan Khatiwoda (born 1984) is a scholar of Indology and history/archaeology who completed his PhD at Heidelberg University (2013–2017). Since 2017, he has held posts at Heidelberg University and the Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities.
Rajaram Hegde is a scholar of history, archaeology, and religious studies who served as Director of both Kuvempu University and the Centre for the Study of Local Cultures (attested 2010).
